whatThisIs: For each title, how many countries put it at number one in their own Netflix Top 10, against how many carried it but never at the top, read from the raw weekly country tables.
whatThisIsNot: Not a global chart position and not a view count. Press lines like "tops the non-English chart for a second week" describe one worldwide list; this counts country lists. The two are different measurements and we do not convert between them.
제목을어떻게골랐나: Titles repeated in our own community and news collection for 2026-09-03 (archive/raw/community-desk/2026-09-03.json, 664 items). Chosen by frequency, not by us.
